THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry Reference No.: 4-3/7/2010/HW/214.
My Reference No. : 2016/03.
I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the land to be acquired:

Lot No. 1-98 (Lots 98) allotments in total extent of about 1.3973 Hectares of land in Preliminary Plan No. BA 688, dated 30.05.2017 prepared by the Badulla District Senior Superintendent of Surveys on behalf of the Surveyor General situated in the Village of Pelgahathenna in the Grama Niladhari Division 89P Pelgahathenna in the Minor Division Kandapallla Korale in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Passara in Badulla District in the Uva Province.
